title: Vendor Performance Note: Lateness Adjustment of Damage Allowances on Paid-in-Full Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
When the vendor ran late, the damage allowance on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order is adjusted for that lateness after it has been rounded to the cent.

**Clause.** The lateness is the number of calendar days by which the ready date is later than the promised ready date. Once the allowance figure has been rounded to the nearest cent, it is adjusted as follows: when the lateness is more than twice the program's vendor delay threshold, the amount is increased by half of itself and rounded to the nearest cent; when it is more than the threshold but not more than twice the threshold, a flat 25.00 is added to it; otherwise the amount is left as it is. The adjusted amount is the allowance booked.

## Bands for the paid-in-full programs

| Program | Threshold (days) | Increased by half | 25.00 added | Left as it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | 14 | more than 28 days late | 15 to 28 days late | 14 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | 10 | more than 20 days late | 11 to 20 days late | 10 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | 10 | more than 20 days late | 11 to 20 days late | 10 days late or less |

## Worked figures (hypothetical Cut-to-Order Flooring order, rounded allowance figure 247.90, promised ready date 1 June)

| Ready date | Days late | Allowance booked |
|---|---|---|
| 9 June | 8 | 247.90 |
| 15 June | 14 | 272.90 |
| 21 June | 20 | 272.90 |
| 22 June | 21 | 371.85 |

The adjustment acts on the figure already rounded to the cent; the half added is half of that rounded figure.
